WP-3.10 (PoC #P3 real-hardware execution) and the end-to-end NCCL submission rejection (frontend half of F-11.6, WP-3.6) remain planned; network-platform counters stay mock per ADR-14.

review_items.title: 修复 I-1~I-4 准入闭环
review_items.validation_requirement: 正反例测试受限 bootstrap/repair、无介质查询、tested 重测和绑定工单复测；不能扩大授权范围。

review_items.title: 范围化门禁与依赖版本
review_items.validation_requirement: A–B/C–D 的证据不能放行 A–C；改目标/端口对/配置/映射/规则或过期即复核。

review_items.title: 物理身份先于映射
review_items.validation_requirement: G2 失败可关联 PhysicalPort/部件，换件保留历史；独立型号预期不能由实际结果自证。

review_items.title: NCCL 通信组调度
review_items.validation_requirement: 资源预留、固定 rank、屏障、失败整组恢复与报告覆盖范围和来源断言。

review_items.title: 执行可靠性和跨通道互斥
review_items.validation_requirement: 注入 commit/publish 崩溃、重投、租约过期、回执丢失；Agent/SSH/BMC 占用冲突拒绝。

review_items.title: 项目隔离前置与多标签页
review_items.validation_requirement: URL 与显式 project_id 一致，缓存/SSE/确认目标冻结，多标签切换和全局授权聚合注入。

review_items.title: 硬件规格和实测基线
review_items.validation_requirement: HGX B300 与 GB300 Arm/rack 分档，兼容矩阵固定版本，缺基线不通过，量纲与公式可查。

review_items.title: BMC 与 cleanup 的恢复边界
review_items.validation_requirement: Nmi 独立，超时 unknown 查询先行，T7 证据处置；客户资源保留、归档与撤销独立验证。 驱动/固件恢复按组件能力选择已验证回滚或人工恢复；unknown 先对账，不盲重试。

review_items.title: 行内操作固定本行
review_items.validation_requirement: 选中 A/B 后 C 行操作仅 C；批量条明确目标数/项目/排除项。

review_items.title: 拖拽执行业务动作
review_items.validation_requirement: 流转按动作权限/证据/版本校验；不能只 PATCH status 绕过复测。

review_items.title: 目标级门禁消除95%放行
review_items.validation_requirement: 95% 为统计，剩余目标分别阻断或限定审批豁免，不冒充 PASS。

review_items.title: 单位与未知状态
review_items.validation_requirement: 指标有单位来源时间范围，Gbps/GB/s 换算正确，Agent 失联不判机器宕机。

review_items.title: 页面数据契约
review_items.validation_requirement: 1h/24h/7d 历史和未来调度真实查询；首开快照/活动订阅/后台取消/断线补齐。

review_items.title: 型号和角色约束
review_items.validation_requirement: 引用型号可退役不可删除，新版本不改存量；storage 禁用可零绑定。

review_items.title: 依赖顺序和容量验证
review_items.validation_requirement: 验证 DAG、端到端计时、资源预算、逻辑设备与真实连接/字节分开，不将 mock 当硬件性能证据。 BMC 延长轮询实际 interval 时必须 degraded 并记录默认 5min SLO 未达，不以调整后的间隔冒充 PASS。

work_package_index.implementation_notes: Go/React skeleton, versioned OpenAPI generation and checks implemented; Agent/sim/proto pipelines remain planned.
Implemented User/Session/LoginThrottle/Project/Membership/Audit/Idempotency ent schemas and checksum-verified migration. Machine/asset/model/port schemas, queue and outbox remain planned.

Simulated execution engine implemented and verified: flows with immutable versions, logical simulation targets, outbox-driven worker, task attempts, run control and reconciliation. Capacity evidence: 2,000 persisted logical targets completed at 100% in 301.6s (seed 42, worker concurrency 8), satisfying the P1 fan-out criterion of 99.5%. Simulation only: no device transport and no hardware acceptance. Hardware channels (SSH, keel-agent, BMC runners) remain planned. Circuit breaker (FR-1.4) verified: a failing flow over the configured threshold (default 5%) flips the execution to paused automatically inside the receipt transaction, with the failure accounting (failed/terminal counts and threshold) recorded as an execution.circuit_breaker_open event; healthy executions never trip. 3 isolated check groups green. Rerun semantics verified: single-target and failed-only rerun re-open terminal executions with fresh attempt chains (attempt numbers continue each target/task chain, honoring the unique key); rerun flips the execution back to dispatching under the same circuit breaker; guards refuse active executions, foreign targets and empty selections; the breaker denominator is now the frozen target population (an early single failure can no longer trip a threshold meant for batch proportions). 4 rerun check groups green, plus the breaker groups re-verified.

work_package_index.evidence: SSH trust state machine verified (FR-1.2 mock channel): Machine.ssh_trust unverified->established->revoked with sticky first-fingerprint capture, restricted trust.bootstrap only on unverified machines, verify rejects fingerprint mismatches without state change, revoked machines recover solely through audited trust.repair (fingerprint rotation), all transitions land in trust_logs with per-machine outcomes and project scoping. 8 isolated check groups green. keel-ctrl key management, authorized_keys injection, agent gRPC/mTLS and the real runner remain planned (real-channel scope).

work_package_index.implementation_notes: Implemented deny-by-default project access, append-only audit writes and create idempotency. Notifications, broader permissions, secret rotation and pagination remain planned.

work_package_index.evidence: BOM import foundation verified (FR-2.1 backend): two-phase preview/commit with classified conflicts (duplicate SN/MAC, invalid SN/hostname, unknown model), zero partial writes; global Machine/PhysicalPort identity with project-scoped ProjectAsset model binding (FR-14.2) and versioning; file versions unique per project. 8 isolated check groups green. ProxyDHCP/iPXE/cloud-init/callback remain planned (real-channel scope).

work_package_index.implementation_notes: Keel keel/rib login illustration, slogan, local login, project shell, and a project-scoped simulated executions view with target registration, execution detail, run control and paginated task attempts. OIDC callback, the Flow designer and the full component catalog remain planned.

work_package_index.evidence: PoC execution package #P1 produced (H-1): poc/selfcheck.sh (prerequisite self-check against the live platform + tool/key/BOM window assertions), poc/run-h1.sh (real-machine driver asserting the ACCEPTANCE H-1 criteria verbatim: HTTP-first boot observation, hostname-vs-BOM, 100% auto trust via platform readback AND direct keel-ctrl SSH probes, ED25519 fingerprint capture), poc/ENVIRONMENT.md (prerequisites checklist), poc/results/CHECKLIST.md (operator observation template). Scripts are POSIX sh; self-check smoke PASSed against the deployed platform and the driver correctly FAILs without real machines. Real-machine execution and backfill remain with the engineering owner (GA gate).

work_package_index.implementation_notes: Media registry implemented: MediaItem with one-way lifecycle uploaded->verified->approved->retired, scope uniqueness (scope,type,name,version), sha256/arch/dependency validation, manifest gate before verification, uploader/approver separation rejecting self-approval, irreversible retirement keeping history readable. Verified: uniqueness 409, digest validation, second-reviewer approval, retired rejects transitions, cross-scope invisible. UI added: project Media tab with registration dialog, one-way transition dialogs and retirement impact notices; real-browser checks cover registration, second-reviewer approval, self-approval rejection and retirement (7 groups). F-1.8 admission is implemented: execution parameters gated by the catalog reject unapproved versions. Artifact bytes (MinIO), distribution logs and cache accounting (F-1.7) remain planned.

Parameter catalog implemented: ParamKey with typed keys (string/enum/version), scope uniqueness, default-in-options validation, retirement blocking checks. Version-typed options derive at read time from approved non-retired media in the same scope, keeping read-only transactions valid. Value checks gate execution parameters against the derived list. Verified: key validation, empty options before approval, approvals extending options with no manual edit, retired keys rejecting resurrection. ParamSelect UI wiring, dependency-matrix interception and template linkage remain planned with WP-3.8/WP-4.5.

Device model library implemented: stable DeviceModel identities with global/project scopes, immutable DeviceModelVersion publishes with content hashes, slot expectations (PCIe slot, expected NIC model, panel port, default role), retirement blocking new references, and a DeviceModelEditor UI per DESIGN-SYSTEM 4.12d. Verified: scope/name and model/version uniqueness (F-14.2), immutable publishes and retirement keeping history readable (F-14.1). BOM binding validation (F-14.3/14.4), panel preview and role plan overrides remain planned with WP-1.7. Scan import added (FR-14.4): one collected server inventory becomes a draft via POST /projects/{id}/models/import; drafts are idempotent by content_hash, never auto-published, and discarded or published through the existing immutable-version path. Also fixed a latent ListModelVersions slot-scan column mismatch exposed by the first slot-bearing publish.
Implemented project list/create/detail and six-role membership isolation. Asset history, SSE and broader project resource scopes remain planned.
Implemented local credentials, operator bootstrap, server sessions, CSRF, Origin checks, throttling, logout/revocation and authorized next. LDAP/OIDC remain planned.

work_package_index.evidence: Redfish collection mock channel verified (FR-3.2/3.5 backend): L1/L2/L3 levels independently scoped and collected, per-machine collection records store raw+structured snapshots with a revision that only advances on success (failures record revision 0), FR-3.2 failure classes (auth_failed/timeout/version_unsupported/partial/credential_expired) are recorded retryably and never overwrite the last good snapshot, freshness derived at read time (fresh/aging/stale) with never-collected machines surfacing as unknown — never as PASS. 8 isolated check groups green. Real BMC HTTP traversal (FR-3.1 DMTF recursive walk), MinIO raw storage, credential-batch vault rotation (FR-3.6) and scheduling (cron/event triggers) remain planned (real-channel scope).

Assets page collection matrix UI verified: per-level (L1/L2/L3) matrix with status/revision/freshness columns, unknown shown for never-collected machines with the FR-3.5 gate hint, batch collect action for managers with a per-pass success summary. Browser acceptance includes the unknown-to-fresh flip through the UI; a real cache-staleness bug surfaced (the matrix query was not invalidated when BOM imports changed the asset set) and is fixed. JSONPath custom views, conditional coloring and export remain planned (WP-2.2 full scope).

Gate evidence contract verified (G1 mock): G1 judges every target machine for a fresh successful L1 collection plus MAC evidence against the BOM, per-machine failures carry reasons; evidence rows are immutable history (re-evaluation appends), conclusions are PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/WAIVED with skipping never recording PASS; waivers store approver, reason, scope and expiry as their own evidence rows and demand a meaningful reason; evidence carries valid_until (24h default) and downstream lookups treat expired/missing as blocked; read-only roles read but cannot judge or waive; unimplemented gates are rejected instead of pretending; evaluation is project-scoped. 8 isolated check groups green. Pre-collection job fanout (GPU/NIC/system fields, DOM degradation markers), G2-G6 judges and the gate dashboard UI remain planned.

LLDP mock channel with the T1-T5 engine verified (FR-4 G2): per-machine versioned snapshots (revision chain), G2 comparison against BOM ports with per-port classification (T1 dead link, T2 peer mismatch only when the BOM carries a peer expectation, T3 DOM thresholds, T4 flapping, T5 escalation when every port of a machine is down), differences keep snapshot evidence and history is never deleted — targeted re-verification submits a new snapshot and closes non-reproduced differences with a resolution note; read-only roles read but cannot submit; snapshots refuse foreign machines. 8 isolated check groups green. lldpd deployment, readiness handshake, real switch-platform ingestion and the difference detail UI remain planned (real-channel scope).

G3 mapping revisions verified (FR-4/3.4.4 mock): publishing is the only write path and appends immutable history — every physical port of the machine is frozen with planned OS interface naming, permanent MAC, BDF, switch port and GPU affinity; guards demand a valid non-expired G1 PASS/waiver covering the machine, zero unresolved line-order differences and exact once-only coverage of every BOM port; republish (part replacement) appends the next sequence referencing the previous revision, never overwriting. BOM ports became referenceable per FR-2.1 via GET machines/{id}/ports. 6 isolated check groups green. BDF synthesis from DeviceModelVersion topology, the mapping detail UI and CMDB feeds remain planned.

Port panel query view verified (FR-4 3.4.5 PortModel, mock): GET machines/{id}/port-panel aggregates per stable PhysicalPort ID the planned OS interface (latest mapping revision), latest link state with source and timestamp (unknown keeps provenance, empty panels never fabricate), DOM summary, LLDP peer from the newest snapshot, and open flapping alerts attached per port; a monitored flag marks whether dynamic monitoring data exists (maintenance keeps last data). 4 isolated check groups green. SSE live updates, the ServerDetailDrawer five-tab UI, PortPanel rendering and event history remain planned.

Issue lifecycle verified (FR-4.7, mock channel): issues created from G2 differences carry the evidence snapshot and source/phase dual markers (source=g2/topology/g5/g6/portmon/bmc, phase=delivery/post-delivery); the state machine is strictly paired open->assigned->in_repair->verify->closed with reopen from closed only — every action matches exactly one status so a mislabelled action can never sneak a state forward; transitions demand the expected version (stale versions answer the current state, ISSUE_VERSION); repairs register the nine-action enumeration with old/new physical tags and meaningful-note validation; closing from verify requires the bound difference to be resolved by a passing targeted re-verification; the full event history persists in issue_events; the board filters by status/source/phase; read-only roles read but cannot act; project scoping refuses foreign differences. 8 isolated check groups green. Drag-swimlane UI, execution binding for targeted re-verification runs and the remaining source feeds (g5/g6/portmon/bmc) remain planned.

Gate board aggregation verified (DESIGN-SYSTEM 4.4 backend): GET /projects/{id}/dashboard answers six gate cards (G1 reads the newest evidence conclusion: no_evidence/fail/pass/waived; G2 reads no_evidence until a judge exists; G3-G6 honestly report not_implemented — the board never fabricates a pass), plus the PRD KPIs: trust states (established/unverified/revoked), open and in-repair issues, unresolved LLDP differences. 6 isolated check groups green. The six-card UI with pass-rate rings, the waiver dialog and the Fleet-side KPI surfaces remain planned frontend work.

PoC execution package #P2 produced (H-2 Redfish L1 + credential batches, H-3 LLDP readback, H-4 mapping compare with the pull-cable T2/T4 drill, H-5 DOM readout with degradation marking, H-13 PCIe topology with independent per-architecture expectations for B300 x86_64 and GB300 Arm). Selfcheck smoke PASSed against the deployed platform; drivers assert each criterion verbatim with operator checklists for the human halves. Real-machine execution and backfill remain with the engineering owner (GA gate).

FR-13 monitoring data plane mock verified: stage policies mirroring the FR-13.2 tier table exactly (intervals spec-fixed per stage, maintenance all-zero) with fixed steady/burst budgets and a 1-4 burst multiplier; changed-items-only ingest (bandwidth O(changes)); flapping alerts derived from the sample stream (3 downs in 10 minutes on one port open exactly one alert, no duplicates while open); maintenance refuses ingest (dynamic monitoring ends after cleanup); alerts readable by members, policy/ingest admin-only, project-scoped. 6 isolated check groups green. Agent heartbeat transport, real /proc sampling, delta/ACK protocol, retention/downsampling, token-bucket shares and the Execution-bound dynamic windows remain the real-channel scope.

ServerDetailDrawer + StatusPillPair verified (DS 4.12/4.12a): per-machine mapping/network badges triple-encoded and clickable (network column independent of mapping existence per the SSOT), a five-tab slide-over drawer (ledger/mapping/port panel/PCIe topology/monitoring) opening directly on the pill's tab, Esc/mask close keeping list context; a one-read fleet-status aggregate backs the whole page plus a machine event stream for the monitoring tab. 5 browser check groups green. ServerLampPanel (needs BMC out-of-band data, FR-16), drawer resize, prev/next navigation, trend charts and SSE live updates remain planned.

PCIe topology verification verified (FR-4.8 mock): versioned snapshots carrying per-device BDF/upstream chains/NUMA/LnkCap-LnkSta plus the nvidia-smi topo -m matrix; expectations declared from the approved model version, never from the machine output; the judge classifies four dimensions (slot path ownership, NUMA layout, NVLink connectivity via per-row NV markers with nvidia-smi row semantics, LnkSta-vs-LnkCap width); T7 diffs record with an escalation flag after two failed repairs (never auto-RMA) and a clean pass resolves and resets; authority checks precede validation. 4 isolated check groups green. Real sysfs/lspci collection and the topology tree UI (FR-4.8.4) remain planned.

T7 topology confusion wired into the FR-4.7 issue loop (FR-4.8.3): source=topology issues bind pcie_diffs rows as evidence with category T7; the close gate resolves against the topology diff; the issues.difference_id FK is replaced by the creation-time existence+resolution check (semantic reference across two evidence tables). 1 new check group (full T7 loop: create, refuse-close-while-unresolved, conforming resubmission, close) green alongside all prior groups. The DL/vendor escalation UI surface remains planned.

ConfigSet engine verified (FR-5.1 mock): configuration as data with keys/schema/scope/template; version-class variables are parameter-catalog placeholders resolved from the frozen snapshot via dotted paths (missing parameters refuse, never half-render); versioned approval with the self-approval block (drafts -> immutable approved, single publish path); per-machine render previews with line diffs against the newest apply; the G3 mapping precondition gates applies only (previews stay read-only); authority precedes validation. 4 isolated check groups green. The four FR-5.2-5.5 renderers, apply-time watchdog/rollback and the ConfigSet UI remain planned (WP-3.2+).

Four batch-config renderers verified against a real API and a real PostgreSQL (FR-5.2-5.5, FR-5.9, mock channels per ADR-14): GPU network config plans per-NIC address/routes/policy from the published mapping and the logical role (unmapped targets preview but never apply); NIC partitioning is generated from the model capability matrix with rate/total-bandwidth/PF/VF registered separately and a before/after diff (capability overflow refuses); GPU-NIC binding renders NCCL_NETDEVS_POLICY with NUMA pinning and treats a cross-NUMA rail as a preview warning and an apply refusal; RoCE import keeps DCQCN/PFC/ETS/MTU/congestion as ConfigSet keys with a pre-apply diff and a post-apply read-back receipt. All four renderers share one read-back contract: a sampled read-back is parsed against the rendered plan and only a full match verifies (a missing sample stays pending, a disagreeing sample is recorded as a mismatch on the apply row). Role-aware rendering (FR-5.9): templates reference logical roles only; the model declares the default role per slot and the project may override a slot (phase-two x710->unused is absorbed without touching the model or the template); only enabled+required roles must be fully bound, a disabled role may sit empty, the compute role cannot be switched off; a role-plan management page exposes the scheme with coverage and missing-binding impact. 12 isolated API check groups + 5 Chromium check groups green. Apply-time watchdog/rollback for config applies and the FR-5.6 driver chain remain planned (WP-3.4).

work_package_index.implementation_notes: Delivered: L1-L5 five-layer orchestration sharing one per-NIC-pair result model; FR-11.2 precheck (fresh G4 evidence, frozen mapping coverage, no blocking alerts, platform handshake freshness) with ReadinessGate integration; quick/full plans with required_path_coverage accounting (complete vs sampled, sampled never claims full-path coverage); T1-T6 failure classification (T6 config class) opening T-tickets into the FR-4.7 loop with source=nettest; G5 evidence persisted only at run conclusion, incomplete runs produce none; rail heat-matrix UI with port-panel linkage; FR-11.6 admission guard API (net_verified = newest G5 PASS/WAIVED unexpired). Network-platform counters are mock (ADR-14); real-hardware five-layer execution is PoC #P3 (WP-3.10); the frontend-disable half of F-11.6 lands with the NCCL submission flow in WP-3.6.

Delivered: six-component capability matrix (gpu_driver/cuda/ofed/doca with rollback_verified, cx8_firmware manual_only, kernel none declared via os/driver/firmware media types); plan lifecycle draft -> precheck (baseline + companion rules + backup presence) -> start (canary first, batch targets pending) -> advance outcomes -> completed/rolled_back/manual_required/aborted; media:// admission resolves only approved media into media://driver/name@version URIs (F-1.8); per-target cache-hit accounting (F-1.7) with transfer log and distribution summary; bounded checksum retries isolate mismatched targets (F-1.6); timeout targets enter reconcile and never blind-retry; firmware failures route to manual recovery and refuse auto-rollback (MANUAL_RECOVERY_REQUIRED); manual disposition requires a note. Machine execution is mock (ADR-14); real-hardware driver rollout is PoC #P3 (WP-3.10).
